title: Understanding Unimodal Distributions
text: A distribution is considered unimodal if it has a single peak. Look at the histogram and identify how many peaks or high points it has. This will help you determine if the distribution is unimodal.

title: Counting Peaks
text: How many peaks do you observe in the histogram?

title: Analyzing the KDE Plot
text: The KDE plot provides a smoothed estimate of the distribution. Compare the KDE line to the histogram to see if it supports the same number of peaks.
